subject: general
question: What was the percentage of India's urban population in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31.16%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total urban population of India is 377 million(31.16%) according to the census 2011.
 
• The percentage of Indians living in urban areas has increased from 27.8 percent in 2001 to 31.16 percent in 2011.
 
• Goa is the most urbanized state with 62.17% of the population living in urban areas.
 
• The Delhi is most urbanized union territory with 62.17%.
